name: Raman
summary: Raman is an acquaintance-turned-prospect who first reached out in Feb 2025 after seeing a story about faceless pages, wanting to tap in on that. In Jan 2026 he came back asking for help acquiring a specific short Instagram handle — @ali — and asked for pricing, but the deal never closed. He followed up again in June 2026 still wanting the handle, saying he can't return to fashion week in a few months without it; the phone owner explained 1-4 letter handle prices have skyrocketed and he's stopped bothering with that market. Open lead: he's motivated and time-pressured but balking at cost, so a quoted price or an alternative handle option could convert him.
key_facts: Introduced himself as Raman in Feb 2025
Originally reached out about faceless pages after seeing an IG story (Feb 2025)
Wants the Instagram handle @ali — believes no one currently has it
Asked for pricing twice (Jan 2026 and June 2026); no price was ever quoted and no sale closed
Told prices on 1-4 letter handles have gone way up; owner isn't actively working that market anymore
Owner noted it's an established market where everyone charges the same
Motivation/deadline: wants the handle before fashion week in a few months (roughly late 2026)
services_discussed: Faceless page / content page setup (initial inquiry, never followed up)
